articleBlocks: I first thought the answer was 'Tool types' because some clues sounded like common tools.
But then I realized that not all clues fit common tool uses.
The clue 'Inclined plane' made me realize the answer was about simple machines.
I was surprised to find that all the clues were types of simple machines.
A simple machine is a basic device that uses a simple mechanism to change the direction of force.
There are several types of simple machines, including wedges, levers, pulleys, inclined planes, and wheel and axle systems.
Each type of simple machine has its own unique characteristics and uses.
The answer to the puzzle is 'Types of simple machine'.
In hindsight, the clues all make sense as types of simple machines.
The puzzle was tricky because the clues were not all obvious, but the answer is clear once you understand the category.

The solve turned when I stopped treating inclined plane as just another clue and asked what kind of simple machine each clue could describe. I was no longer trying to rescue tool types; I was checking whether Wedge and Lever could survive the same tighter read.

Then I used Pulley, Inclined plane, and Wheel and axle as the confirmation round. Pulley, Inclined plane, and Wheel and axle stayed inside simple machines, so the answer felt earned instead of guessed. The answer was Types of simple machines.
